title: The Bandwagon Fallacy Explained in 1 Minute
skills: define and recognize the bandwagon fallacy
identify claims that rely on popularity as proof
distinguish widespread belief from credible evidence
evaluate arguments for logical relevance and sufficient support
alignment_note: Explains the bandwagon fallacy, in which popularity or widespread acceptance is treated as evidence that a claim is true or correct. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, rhetorical analysis, media literacy, argument evaluation, and critical thinking across high school English courses.
